competing_explanation: The policy may have changed, or the 30-day window may apply only to certain item categories, making the claim outdated or misapplied.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items.
refutation_criterion: H_R is refuted if the current authoritative policy states a different full-refund return window for standard items, such as 14 days, 60 days, or no full-refund window.
